info.title: Mac MCP REST API v2
info.description: Versioned REST surface generated from the Mac MCP tool contract: POST /api/v2/<tool> takes the MCP tool's input schema and runs through the same policy, approvals, telemetry, idempotency_key and error contract as MCP. Failures return {error: {code, stage, outcome, retry}}. The unversioned /api routes remain available unchanged.

Result.description: Completed call; the tool's own result (it may report ok=false).

Error.description: Failed call (status from the error contract).

element_id.description: Id from browser_observe/browser_find; or describe the target with query/role/text_match.

query.description: Words for the target, e.g. 'Email field', 'Continue'.

role.description: ARIA role, e.g. button, link, textbox, combobox.

within.description: Phrase unique to one repeated item; limits matching to it.

intent.description: Optional; only breaks ties between equal targets.

text.description: type/type_text/paste: text to enter. wait for=text: text to wait for.

handoff_id.description: type/paste: sealed handoff from context_handoff instead of text.

key.description: key/keyboard/shortcut: Enter, Escape, Tab, ArrowDown or one character.

for.description: wait: selector (default), text, element_removed, url_change, network_idle, dom_stable.
